name: T.G. Krishnamurti
relation: UG's maternal grandfather, a wealthy Brahmin lawyer and prominent Theosophist who gave up his practice to raise UG after his mother's death.
material: No material of his own survives online; he is the subject of UG's childhood recollections in Mahesh Bhatt's biography and in UG's own talks.

name: UG's grandmother (wife of T.G. Krishnamurti)
relation: UG's maternal grandmother, who with her husband raised him in Gudivada; UG often recalled her ritual orthodoxy and the household's spiritual atmosphere.
material: Recalled in UG's talks and in Bhatt's biography; no independent material.

name: Bharati (UG's mother)
relation: UG's mother, who died seven days after his birth in Masulipatam (9 July 1918); she is said to have told her father that the child was born with the destiny of a great man.
material: Subject of the deathbed-prophecy anecdote repeated in all biographies.

name: UG's father (Uppaluri family)
relation: UG's father, who remarried soon after his wife's death and left the boy to be raised by the maternal grandparents; UG barely knew him.
material: Mentioned only in passing in biographies.

name: Kusuma Kumari
relation: UG's wife, married 1943 in an arranged marriage; they had four children and separated in the US in the late 1950s; she died in 1963 after a period in a mental institution.
material: Subject of the chapter 'Kusuma—U.G.'s Wife' in Stopped in Our Tracks and of UG's own account of his married years (Bhatt biography ch. 4, 'Locking of Horns').

name: Bharati (UG's daughter)
relation: UG's elder daughter, named after his mother; photographed with him in later life.
material: Appears in family photographs on the WELL biography photo pages.

name: Vasant (UG's son)
relation: UG's elder son, who contracted polio as a child; UG took the family to the US (1955–59) for his treatment, which exhausted their savings. Vasant later died in India with UG at his bedside (c. 1980s).
material: Photographed with UG (WELL photo 'ug_n_son'); his illness and death recounted in Bhatt's biography.

name: Usha (UG's daughter)
relation: UG's younger daughter, resident in Bangalore, who attends the annual 22 March gatherings for UG; her account of the family appears in Mahesh Bhatt's biography.
material: Interviewed in Bhatt's 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life'; photographed on the WELL biography pages.

name: Kumar (UG's younger son)
relation: UG's fourth child, born in Chicago in 1957 while UG worked there; taken back to India by his mother, he first met his father again at about 17; he settled with his family in Virginia, USA, where UG visited them. Named in UG's obituary with his family as survivors.
material: Subject of the chapter 'Kumar, U.G.'s Son' in Stopped in Our Tracks; WELL photo 'With his son and his family in Virginia'.

name: Swami Sivananda
relation: Rishikesh yogi with whom UG studied classical yoga and meditation for seven summers (c. 1932–39) as a teenager; UG lost faith after seeing him secretly eating pickles.
material: UG's recollections of him appear in The Mystique of Enlightenment and the Bhatt biography.

name: Ramana Maharshi
relation: Sage of Tiruvannamalai whom UG visited in 1939; UG asked 'Can you give me what you have?' and the reply 'I can give it, but can you take it?' set him on his own search.
material: The 1939 exchange is quoted in every UG biography.

name: Annie Besant
relation: President of the Theosophical Society; UG's grandfather was a close associate, and UG grew up in the Society's Adyar milieu where he encountered her.
material: Context for UG's Theosophical years (1930s–40s).

name: C.W. Leadbeater
relation: Theosophical clairvoyant whom UG, as a boy, watched 'test' with questions at Adyar and came to regard as a fraud; a formative disillusionment.
material: Recounted in UG's talks (Mystique of Enlightenment) and Bhatt's biography.

name: Jiddu Krishnamurti
relation: The famous Theosophical 'World Teacher' whom UG heard at Adyar from 1947 and met privately over seven years, breaking with him in 1953; UG later encountered him once more in Saanen (1960s). Included here only as a relation to UG.
material: UG's account of the break ('you have nothing to give me') appears in all his books; a 1967 Saanen encounter preceded UG's 'calamity'.

name: D. Rajagopal
relation: Jiddu Krishnamurti's business manager (KWINC), who in UG's account mediated and finally blocked UG's attempts to see J.K. in the early 1950s; UG also later met him in Ojai.
material: Mentioned in UG's recollections of the J. Krishnamurti years.

name: Valentine de Kerven
relation: Swiss retired consulate employee who met UG in Geneva after Christmas 1963 (she was 63), gave him shelter and a chalet in Saanen, funded him, and travelled with him for 27 years until her death in Bangalore.
material: Present at the 1968 Bohm conversation; subject of the 'Valentine de Kerven' chapter in Stopped in Our Tracks; many photographs on the WELL site.

name: K. Chandrasekhar
relation: Bangalore engineer whose modest house 'Poornakutee' (Basavanagudi) was UG's Indian base for over four decades; his notebooks became 'Stopped in Our Tracks: Stories of U.G. in India' (co-written with Narayana Moorty, Smriti 2005).
material: Diaries/notebooks; co-author of Stopped in Our Tracks; hosts the annual 22 March gathering at 'Hridaya Vihar'.

name: Suguna Chandrasekhar
relation: Wife of K. Chandrasekhar; cooked for and hosted UG at Poornakutee, Bangalore, for decades and continued hosting friends' memorial gatherings after 2007.
material: Features throughout Stopped in Our Tracks and The Sage and the Housewife.

name: Brahmachari Sivarama Sarma
relation: Bangalore Sanskrit scholar and lifelong celibate who left a mutt succession dispute and was sheltered by UG; a central character in Stopped in Our Tracks.
material: Chapters about him in Stopped in Our Tracks; blog memoir 'A home called Parvathi'.

name: Krishna Bhagavatar
relation: Bangalore musician/devotee who asked UG for 'if not moksha, at least a transistor'; subject of a chapter in Stopped in Our Tracks.
material: Anecdote preserved in Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: Nagaraj
relation: Bangalore friend who appears in Stopped in Our Tracks asking UG what he is trying to convey.
material: Dialogue preserved in Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: NIMHANS doctors: Dr R. Marthanda Varma, Dr T. Desiraju, Dr R.L. Kapur
relation: Senior NIMHANS (Bangalore) neuroscientists – founder-director Varma, neurophysiologist Desiraju (1935–1992) and former director Kapur – who with six colleagues questioned UG for 2.5 hours about his physiological 'natural state'.
material: Visit recorded in Stopped in Our Tracks; no published study.

name: Mahesh Bhatt
relation: Bombay film director who met UG in 1979 (introduced via Parveen Babi), became a close friend for 28 years, wrote 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life' (Viking 1992; 2001 ed. adds 'A Taste of Death'), was present at UG's death and is executive producer of 'The Natural State' (2026).
material: Biography; filmed conversations (archive.org 'U.G. in Conversation with Mahesh Bhatt'); foreword to Mukunda Rao's book.

name: Parveen Babi
relation: Bollywood actress whom Mahesh Bhatt took to UG in Bangalore (c. 1979–80) during her mental breakdown; UG looked after her for a period, which is how Bhatt came to know him.
material: Episode recounted in Bhatt's biography and in Karishma Upadhyay's 'Parveen Babi: A Life' (2020).

name: Julie Thayer
relation: New Yorker (Upper West Side) who upended her life in 1989 to travel with UG until his death, keeping a journal and shooting hundreds of hours of camcorder video; her footage forms the basis of 'The Natural State' (2026).
material: Video archive 1989–2007; book/journal 'Travels with UG' and 'Get Lost and Stay Lost / UG Krishnamurti Cookbook'; travelswithug.com.

name: Louis Brawley
relation: New York artist/photographer who met UG in 2002 and travelled with him for five years as informal caregiver; author of 'Goner: The Final Travels of UG Krishnamurti' (Non-Duality Press 2011).
material: Memoir 'Goner'; photographs; filmed talks with Willem de Ridder about UG; BatGap interview #177.

name: Terry Newland
relation: Mill Valley, California friend (earlier Terry Agnew) in whose studio apartment UG stayed on US visits; edited 'Mind is a Myth' (Dinesh 1988; Sentient 2007) despite UG's objections.
material: Editor of Mind is a Myth; appears in Narayana Moorty's and others' memoirs.

name: Rodney Arms
relation: Editor of the first UG book, 'The Mystique of Enlightenment' (Dinesh Vaghela/Cemetile, Goa 1982) and later co-editor of 'The Biology of Enlightenment' (HarperCollins India).
material: Editor of Mystique of Enlightenment and Biology of Enlightenment.

name: J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty
relation: Telugu-born philosophy professor (Monterey Peninsula College 1974–2000), friend of UG from the 1970s; co-edited 'Thought is Your Enemy' and 'No Way Out' with Frank Noronha, co-wrote 'Stopped in Our Tracks', wrote the introduction to 'The Sage and the Housewife', and maintains the WELL UG archive.
material: Editor/translator; curator of people.well.com/user/jct (streaming video, books, bibliography); blog memoirs of travels with UG.

name: Wendy Moorty
relation: Wife of Narayana Moorty, Seaside, California; credited for editorial assistance on 'Stopped in Our Tracks' and present at many UG gatherings in California.
material: Editorial assistance on Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: Larry Morris
relation: Albuquerque minister (Hillside Community Church) and poet with a 21-year friendship with UG; author of 'U.G. Krishnamurti: Dangerous Friend', 'The Natural Man: Poems on U.G.', 'Living Treasure' and 'A Journey of Healing'; present at UG's death in Vallecrosia.
material: Books and poems on UG; eyewitness to UG's last days.

name: Susan Morris
relation: Physician turned associate minister at Hillside Church, Albuquerque, partner of Larry Morris; travelled with UG and was present at his death in Vallecrosia in 2007.
material: Eyewitness to UG's last days; Hillside Church UG materials.

name: Anthony Paul Frank Noronha
relation: Bangalore friend and co-editor (with Narayana Moorty) of 'Thought is Your Enemy' (1990) and 'No Way Out' (1991); his family firm Sowmya Publishers issued UG titles. Quoted in UG's 2007 obituaries on the absence of funeral rites.
material: Co-editor of two UG dialogue books; publisher.

name: Sowmya Noronha
relation: Member of the Noronha family after whom Sowmya Publishers, Bangalore (publisher of 'The Sage and the Housewife', 1990, and other UG books) is named.
material: Sowmya Publishers imprint.

name: Ellen Chrystal
relation: Transcribed and edited 'The Courage to Stand Alone' (Plover Press 1997; Non-Duality Press reissue) from Henk Schonewille's audio recordings.
material: Editor of Courage to Stand Alone.

name: Henk Schonewille
relation: Dutch friend who made the audio recordings of UG in Amsterdam that became 'The Courage to Stand Alone'; wrote the foreword to the Non-Duality Press edition.
material: Audio recordings (Amsterdam, 1990s); foreword.

name: Peter Maverick
relation: Compiled and edited 'The Natural State: In the Words of U.G. Krishnamurti' (Smriti 2005) and put the full text of 'Courage to Stand Alone' online at thenaturalman.blogspot.com.
material: Anthology; online texts.

name: Mukunda Rao
relation: Bangalore novelist and long-term friend; author of 'The Other Side of Belief: Interpreting U.G. Krishnamurti' (Penguin 2005, foreword Mahesh Bhatt), 'The Penguin U.G. Krishnamurti Reader' (2007) and 'The Biology of Enlightenment' (ed., HarperCollins 2011).
material: Biography, reader anthology, edited transcripts.

name: Shanta Kelker
relation: Bombay-born (1948) Bangalore housewife who met UG in 1980 and kept diaries of her conversations with him, published as 'The Sage and the Housewife' (Sowmya 1990; Smriti 2005).
material: Diary-based memoir with introduction by Narayana Moorty.

name: Dinesh Vaghela
relation: Goa-based publisher (Cemetile Corporation, P.O. Betim-Volant) who issued the first editions of 'The Mystique of Enlightenment' (1982, 5000 copies) and 'Mind is a Myth' (1988). Still attends the annual 22 March UG gathering in Bangalore (2018).
material: First publisher of UG's books.

name: Jeff Kaplan
relation: Internet Archive staff member listed as creator of the 'U.G. Krishnamurti conversations and interviews – audio' (80 items) and companion video collections on archive.org.
material: archive.org collections ugkrishnamurti-audio / -video.

name: Dr Raj Mehta
relation: Bombay friend present at the 1995 Nadi astrological reading of UG's horoscope (with K.C. Joshi and Dhiren & Minal Morarji); associated with the 'Essential UG' web material.
material: Transcript of 1995 Nadi reading; Essential UG materials.

name: Sunita Pant Bansal
relation: New Delhi publisher (Smriti Books / SPB Enterprises) and curator who reissued the UG canon 2003–2007 as co-editor; author of 'The Ashes Are Warm: Memories of a Lifetime Spent with UG Krishnamurti' (Rupa 2026).
material: Smriti Books editions; memoir.

name: Matthew Dougherty
relation: Director of 'The Natural State' (2026, 99–100 min), built from Julie Thayer's 1989–2007 camcorder archive and journals; premiered Telluride, September 2026.
material: Documentary film.

name: Jane Campion
relation: New Zealand director, executive producer of 'The Natural State' (2026) alongside Mahesh Bhatt.
material: Executive producer credit.

name: Willem de Ridder
relation: Dutch Fluxus artist and radio host who interviewed UG several times in Amsterdam (with Byron Katie, 1998; solo 18 Jan 2002; 'Thought is Destructive'); later recorded talks with Louis Brawley about UG.
material: Audio/video interviews on archive.org, SoundCloud, YouTube.

name: Byron Katie
relation: American teacher ('The Work') who co-interviewed UG with Willem de Ridder in Amsterdam, 1998.
material: Audio/video interview.

name: Luc Sala
relation: Dutch media entrepreneur who interviewed UG in his Amsterdam studio in 2000 for Kleurnet TV.
material: Full video interview (YouTube).

name: Rajiv Mehrotra
relation: Host of Doordarshan's 'In Conversation'; interviewed UG for Indian television in February 1989 (c. 30 min).
material: TV interview (YouTube, archive.org).

name: Shashi Kumar
relation: Indian television journalist whose conversation with UG survives as an archive.org audio item.
material: TV interview audio.

name: Jeffrey Mishlove
relation: Host of PBS 'Thinking Allowed'; recorded two UG programmes, 'The Mystique of Enlightenment' (October 1988) and 'Mind as a Myth' (1992), with transcript at intuitionnetwork.org.
material: Two TV interviews, DVD, transcript.

name: Iain McNay
relation: Founder of Conscious TV (UK); an interview with UG is listed in the UG archives.
material: Interview recording.

name: Bryce Bond
relation: Host of the US cable programme 'Dimensions in Parapsychology'; his conversation with UG is on archive.org.
material: TV interview video.

name: Donald Ingram Smith
relation: Australian ABC radio broadcaster who interviewed UG in Sydney on 7 and 16 March 1990 and for ABC in September 1990.
material: Radio interviews (archive.org, SoundCloud).

name: Paul Collins
relation: Australian broadcaster in conversation with UG in Sydney, 15 March 1990.
material: Audio recording.

name: Barbara Schuler
relation: Presenter at KAZU Radio (Pacific Grove, California) who interviewed UG in May 1989.
material: Radio interview audio.

name: David Bohm
relation: Quantum physicist who conversed with UG in Saanen on 17 August 1968 (with Saral Bohm, David Barry and Valentine de Kerven present); Bohm's part was adapted as a chapter in 'A Question of Physics'.
material: Recorded 1968 conversation (archive.org, YouTube).

name: S.C. Birla
relation: Indian industrialist of the Birla family who held recorded discussions with UG in Gstaad, Switzerland, in 1989.
material: Two-part audio 'U.G. with S.C. Birla' on archive.org.

name: Douglas White
relation: Participant in a recorded discussion with UG preserved as audio (SoundCloud / fan archives).
material: Audio discussion.

name: Susan Dean
relation: Interviewer whose recording with UG is listed among 'Essential Audios' on ugkrishnamurti.in.
material: Audio interview.

name: Nicolas C. Grey
relation: British artist who drew the graphic biography 'This Dog Barking: The Strange Story of U.G. Krishnamurti' (2017).
material: Graphic novel.

name: James Farley
relation: Writer/editor of 'This Dog Barking: The Strange Story of U.G. Krishnamurti' (2017) with Nicolas C. Grey.
material: Graphic novel text.

name: Uma Balaji
relation: Bangalore writer whose memoir 'My Journey With UG Krishnamurti' (guest article) describes meeting UG at Poornakutee and the Chandrasekhars.
material: Memoir essay.

name: Lucia, Anita and Giovanni (Vallecrosia hosts)
relation: Italian friends who built an apartment for UG in their villa at Vallecrosia (Liguria), where he spent his last weeks and died on 22 March 2007.
material: Hosts of UG's final residence; eyewitnesses.

name: Mark Whitwell
relation: New Zealand-born yoga teacher (student of Krishnamacharya and Desikachar) who first met UG in Bangalore in 1973 and was a friend until 2007, mostly in Australia and Switzerland; founder of Heart of Yoga, which cites UG as a root influence.
material: Interviews and essays on UG (Medium, heartofyoga.com); podcast; recollection of Ram Dass's meeting with UG.

name: Rosalind Atkinson
relation: Heart of Yoga co-author and podcast host who travelled with Mark Whitwell and conducted the two-part 'Understanding U.G. Krishnamurti' interviews with him.
material: Interviews/essays on UG via Heart of Yoga.

name: Arun Babani
relation: Mumbai journalist and Sindhi poet who compiled 'UG Says: Everyday Thoughts by UG Krishnamurti' (HarperCollins India 2018; foreword Mahesh Bhatt, introduction Mukunda Rao).
material: Quotation anthology.

name: Sripada Gopalakrishnamurti
relation: Hyderabad friend (circle of B.L. Narayan and Prasada Rao at the Oasis School) who debated death and the afterlife with UG, wrote a book on Sri Jillellamudi Amma, and pressed Chandrasekhar to write UG's biography; died before seeing it.
material: Figures in Stopped in Our Tracks (Hyderabad chapters).

name: B.L. Narayan and Prasada Rao
relation: Hyderabad friends who, with Sripada Gopalakrishnamurti, regularly hosted and argued with UG during his stays at the Oasis School, Hyderabad.
material: Named in Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: Chalam
relation: Celebrated Telugu writer living at Tiruvannamalai, old friend of UG; he came to Bangalore yearly to see UG, and UG travelled to Arunachala when Chalam was dying. His daughter Sowris was UG's distant cousin.
material: Recalled in 'How I Met UG' (ugarchive) and Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: Vazir Rahman
relation: Friend of K. Chandrasekhar who met him weekly and urged him to render UG's words into simple, clear Telugu, shaping the Telugu notebooks behind Stopped in Our Tracks.
material: Editorial help on the Telugu source text.

name: Mario Viggiano
relation: Italian friend of UG who drove for him in Palm Springs and was present with Julie Thayer at a 1995 Corte Madera gathering.
material: Named in Palm Springs diaries and Moorty's blog.

name: Dr K.B. Ramakrishna Rao
relation: Professor of Philosophy at Mysore University and early Karnataka friend; the first book on UG (in Kannada) was released at his Mysore house. A recorded conversation with him, Brahmachari and Chandrasekhar survives.
material: archive.org audio 'Conversation with Dr K.B. Rao, Bramchari & Chandrashekar Babu'.

name: Major Dakshinamurti
relation: Retired Indian Army major described as a close friend of UG in Bangalore.
material: Named in Uma Balaji's memoir / Bangalore accounts.

name: Lakshmi and Guha
relation: Indian-American couple (Guha a scientist) who became close to UG in his last decade; Guha's diary was published as 'In Palm Springs with U.G. Krishnamurti', and 'Lakshmi and Guha' chapters appear in the 1998–99 Palm Springs & Gstaad diaries.
material: Book 'In Palm Springs with U.G. Krishnamurti'; diary chapters.

name: Michael Toms
relation: Founder-host of 'New Dimensions' radio; interviewed UG on 14 November 1989 (transcript in the New Dimensions Media records, Stanford).
material: Radio interview audio (archive.org); transcript in OAC finding aid.

name: John Wren-Lewis
relation: British-born scientist and writer on religion, honorary associate at the University of Sydney, who took part in a recorded four-part 1991 Sydney conversation with UG together with John Cooper and Donald Ingram Smith.
material: 1991 Sydney audio (WELL archive, remembering-ug blog).

name: John Cooper
relation: Sydney participant in the recorded 1991 conversation with UG alongside John Wren-Lewis and Donald Ingram Smith.
material: 1991 Sydney audio.

name: Ramola Bachchan
relation: Indian television presenter who interviewed UG on the programme 'Face to Face' (6 June 1993).
material: Video and audio on archive.org; multi-part audio on fan blogs.

name: Rochaldas Shroff
relation: Former J. Krishnamurti follower (with Nagaraj, Radhakishan Bajaj and Narayanachari) drawn to UG after a 1970s talk; subject of the chapter 'You Are the Only One Who Gives What I Need Free of Charge' in Stopped in Our Tracks.
material: Chapter in Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: Dilip Kothari
relation: Bombay friend of UG, former Chairman of the Film Censor Board.
material: Named in Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: Henry (English friend with Bombay house)
relation: Friend of UG from England with a house and business office in Bombay where UG and Valentine stayed on their Indian visits after the 1967 'calamity'.
material: Named in Stopped in Our Tracks.

name: Kanubhai C. Joshi, Dhiren and Minal Morarji
relation: Bombay friends present with Raj Mehta at the 1995 Nadi astrological reading of UG's horoscope; Joshi conducted the reading.
material: Transcript of 1995 Nadi reading.

name: Ram Dass
relation: American spiritual teacher who met UG; Mark Whitwell recalls him moved to tears recounting the encounter.
material: Anecdote via Mark Whitwell.

name: Joel Staffeleu
relation: Dutch participant in a 1990 Amsterdam video conversation with UG listed in the WELL streaming archive.
material: Video (WELL archive).

name: David Barry
relation: Present with Saral Bohm and Valentine at the 17 August 1968 Saanen conversation between UG and David Bohm.
material: Participant in the 1968 Bohm recording.

name: Bangalore memorial circle (Dr Leele, Uday Puranik, Vikas Deshpande, R.P. Jhunjhunwala)
relation: Friends who gather each 22 March at the Chandrasekhars' home 'Hridaya Vihar', Bangalore, for the UG anniversary meet (attendees recorded 2018).
material: Blog reports of annual gatherings (sulochanosho).
